englishDefinition: Declare formally; declare someone to be something; of titles. (2) State or announce.

persianMeaning: ساختار پایه‌ای، چارچوب اصلی، راز شرم‌آور، اسرار پنهان
englishDefinition: Something reduced to its minimal form. (2) Scandal that is kept secret. (3) The internal supporting structure that gives an artifact its shape.

englishDefinition: Of or relating to a phenomenon. (2) Exceedingly or unbelievably great.

englishDefinition: The state of being certain. (2) Something that is certain.
